title: Fried Chicken
desc: Charred Shou Sugi Ban wood meets the austere warmth of an off-white architectural backdrop in a raw, minimalist culinary studio. Crisp Korean Fried Chicken rests on handcrafted ceramic, its glassy Gochujang glaze catching a sharp beam of left-side daylight as a delicate crack breaks through the sticky crimson crust.
businessBrief: High-impact culinary motion capturing searing steam, dripping cheese, and textural layering—built for viral fast-casual campaigns and elevated comfort concepts.
